title: Preference-Based Reward Learning under Partial Observability with Inexact Dynamics
summary: In this paper, we study how partial observability and inexact latent-state inference affect reward learning from preferences. To that end, we study preference-based reward learning under partial observability, where the learner forms latent-state estimates using an inexact learned POMDP model, so model error can accumulate over time. For finite log-linear POMDPs, we characterize this error term by establishing the stability of the belief filter to parametric model error under certain mixing conditions, yielding bounds on the belief mismatch in expectation and in high probability.
